article.title: Sally Rooney’s books withdrawn from UK market over Palestine solidarity
article.author: Editor
article.content: Irish novelist Sally Rooney’s publisher has halted UK distribution of her books, citing terrorism legislation linked to her Palestine Action support. The post Sally Rooney’s books withdrawn from UK market over Palestine solidarity appeared first on MR Online .
